::: {.home-lead}
**scjn** is the client for the Suprema Corte de Justicia de la Nación's SCOW
JSON API (the backend of `legislacion.scjn.gob.mx/consulta`), the writer of
the Markdown snapshots of an instrument's reforms, and the disk-first reader
of the four SCJN releases: `scjn-leyes`, `scjn-reglamentos`,
`scjn-lineamientos` and `scjn-tratados`. Each snapshot carries a
`fuente: scjn` provenance header.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## The SCJN is not an official source of legal text

The *Diario Oficial de la Federación* (DOF) is, and it is read through
[dofjson](https://legistlan.github.io/dofjson/). `fuente: scjn` in a
provenance header means exactly that: the text is the SCJN's consolidated
view, a convenience corpus and never a replacement for the gazette.
:::

::: {.fronts}
::: {.front}
### Four releases

`scjn-leyes` (315 federal laws, reform-dated snapshots, keyed by `abrev`) and
the id-keyed `scjn-reglamentos`, `scjn-lineamientos` and `scjn-tratados`
(keyed by `id_ordenamiento`).
:::
::: {.front}
### Disk-first readers

Every reader reads the cache and raises `AssetNotCached` rather than
downloading; only `scjn download` and the `download_*_assets` functions talk
to the network.
:::
::: {.front}
### An outline that changes no text

One marker line per block that yields text; `strip_markers` returns the text
byte for byte.
:::
:::

## Quickstart

```bash
pip install scjn
scjn download --slug lfca
```

```python
from scjn import download_scjn_leyes_index, download_scjn_leyes_corpus, markdown_de_snapshot

index = download_scjn_leyes_index()           # the release's index, off the cache
corpus = download_scjn_leyes_corpus("lfca")   # one law's tarball contents, off the cache
text = markdown_de_snapshot("lfca", "<snapshot file name>")  # one reform, as Markdown
```

See [Install](pages/install.qmd) for what the package needs,
[Command line](pages/cli.qmd) and [Python](pages/python.qmd) for the two ways
to read a release, [Releases](pages/releases.qmd) for how the four releases are
laid out, [Outline](pages/outline.qmd) for the marker lines and the
completeness guard, and [Crawl](pages/crawl.qmd) for the scripts that produce a
release. Extending the package itself is documented separately, on the
[developer docs](https://legistlan.github.io/scjn/dev/).
